data.long_meaning: The name Jeisha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jaya', which means victory or success. In Hindu mythology, Jeisha is the goddess of wealth and prosperity, often depicted with a lotus in her hand and seated on a lotus flower. She is believed to bestow wealth, success, and good fortune upon her devotees. The name Jeisha carries the meaning “Goddess of wealth and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jeisha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jeisha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of wealth and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeisha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
